opening_question: Namaste. Badan dard ke baare mein bataiye — kahan aur kab se ho raha hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Dard shareer mein kahan hai — poore badan mein ya kisi khaas jagah?
Dard kaisa hai — jakdan (stiffness), khinchav, ya tez dard?
1 se 10 ke beech dard kitna tez hai?
Kis cheez se dard badhta hai — movement se, ya aaram karne par bhi rehta hai?

screening_questions.question: Badan dard ke saath bukhaar bhi hai?
Kamzori ya chalne-firne mein dikkat mehsoos hoti hai?
Kisi joint ya jagah par sujan (swelling) hai?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi arthritis, thyroid, ya aisi koi bimari hui hai?
Koi dawai already chal rahi hai?
